stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"A company's page lists its provident and study funds but not its index-tracking funds or money-market funds.","where":"the product choices at the top of the company page","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Doesn't know which product (pension, study fund, investment fund) their own savings are in, so isn't sure the track or fee applies to them
Can't tell whether 0.56% is cheap: nothing compares Harel to other companies
Didn't know what the 'השוואה למטרה' menu item means
Unsure whether they'd personally pay the average fee shown in the intro
The '123 ממקור · 123 מחושב · 123 הזנתה' line is confusing and meaningless
Product tabs are confusing: can't tell which tab is theirs, and 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' means nothing to them
Investment-category buttons like 'אג"ח סחיר', 'כספי (שקלי)', 'הלכה' are not understood
The extra-costs note raises worry about hidden costs; the 'PF-10' tag is meaningless
Doesn't know the terms in the collapsed sections 'קרנות מחקות', 'מרכזית לפיצויים', 'קרנות סל'
The 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' list looks like fine print and would be cut
Most table rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so there's no return data for them
The 'קופה' numbers column is meaningless
Ring chart and 'מניות/מט"ח' breakdown: doesn't understand why foreign currency matters
Unclear difference between 'מההיסכון' and 'מההפקדה'
Confusing category counts: the S&P 500 button says 1 but 'הכול' says 16
Unsure whether 24.04% is really per year; seems too good to be true
Returns are shown before fees and tax, and there's no after-fee figure for what they'd actually get
Can't see what 0.56% means in shekels for their savings
No simple explanation of which product suits someone like them (24, salaried)
Can't find how to actually switch tracks
Would cut the company legal names line, the repeated '0% מההפקדה' line, and the search box

problems.why: The reader never says index-tracking or money-market funds are missing from the product choices. They only say they don't understand the words in the collapsed sections 'קרנות מחקות' and 'קרנות סל', which is a different complaint.
